channel.description: B2B marketing intelligence for the AI era -- SEO, GEO, and AI search visibility for SaaS companies.

item.title: Beyond Cross-Border: Where India's Global-Payments Brands Actually Earn Their Backlinks · rawmktg.
item.description: Ahrefs link-intersect data across Cashfree, PayGlocal, Skydo, Infinity, Eximpay and Xflow. ~9,515 referring pages from ~1,788 unique domains classified by topic. Cross-border/remittance is not the largest link category. Software/developer and payment-gateway/fintech content lead. Exports, compliance and freelancing are underserved adjacent topics.

item.title: When Buyers Ask AI Which AEC Software to Use, Most Vendors Aren't in the Room · rawmktg.
item.description: Data analysis of LLM citation visibility across 6 AEC software platforms. 4 of 6 companies have fewer than 2 total AI citations. Google AI Overviews and Grok account for 77% of all citations. Zero companies have published llms.txt. Includes the full citation matrix, platform behavior analysis, visibility factor matrix, and a prioritized action plan for vendors.

item.title: How We Run a GEO Foundation Audit · rawmktg.
item.description: A repeatable five-step diagnostic for mapping brand citation visibility across ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini, and Claude. Covers query mapping with buyer-intent prompts, multi-model execution, citation gap scoring, technical AI crawlability, and content restructuring using Princeton-validated operators. AI-referred traffic converts at 11x organic. Only 11% of domains are cited by both ChatGPT and Perplexity.

item.title: The Topical Authority Cluster That Gets B2B Brands Into AI Shortlists · rawmktg.
item.description: How generative engines weigh topical depth against breadth, and the exact hybrid cluster architecture that earns a place on LLM recommendation lists. Covers RAG pipeline mechanics, Princeton GEO-bench findings (+41% from statistics), five citability pillars, an 8-question audit, cluster architecture with per-engine distribution tactics, llms.txt implementation, and Share of Model measurement.

item.title: Why ChatGPT, Perplexity and Gemini Cite Different Vendors · rawmktg.
item.description: ChatGPT, Perplexity, and Gemini pull from different data sources and weight different signals. A technical breakdown of each engine's retrieval logic and a prioritisation matrix for B2B SaaS brands.

item.title: Prompt-to-Citation Tracking: Build a GEO Measurement Stack · rawmktg.
item.description: How to build a GEO measurement stack from zero: prompt portfolios, GA4 AI search attribution, custom Looker Studio dashboard, and Revenue per Citation -- the metrics that prove AI visibility ROI.

item.title: Stop AI Getting Your Brand Wrong: GEO Content Architecture · rawmktg.
item.description: The specific markup, FAQ architecture, and claim-anchoring techniques that measurably reduce AI hallucinations about your brand -- grounded in the Princeton GEO study and real RAG pipeline mechanics.

item.title: Schema Markup for AI Citations: 2026 B2B Playbook · rawmktg.
item.description: 53% of AI-cited pages have valid schema markup. A complete technical playbook covering @graph architecture, FAQPage, Article, SoftwareApplication, and HowTo schema for B2B SaaS brands competing for AI citations.

item.title: How AI Crawlers Index Your Site: GPTBot vs. Perplexity · rawmktg.
item.description: Three crawlers, three indexing logics, one robots.txt. A side-by-side breakdown of OAI-SearchBot, PerplexityBot, and CCBot: crawl frequency, scope, JavaScript handling, IP verification, and the unified configuration that keeps your site visible to citation engines without leaking content to training corpora.

item.title: GEO Compounding Flywheel: Build Durable AI Visibility · rawmktg.
item.description: A seven-step loop (Build, Crawl, Train/Retrieve, Rate, Recommend, Validate, Re-signal) is quietly deciding which B2B brands LLMs will recommend for the next decade. The brands that start the loop now will be the ones impossible to unseat later.

item.title: E-E-A-T Is an AI Signal Now: LLM Preferences Explained · rawmktg.
item.description: E-E-A-T is no longer a qualitative guideline for human raters. It is mathematically encoded into LLM parameter weights through RLHF and DPO training pipelines. A technical breakdown of how it works and a 90-day execution plan.

item.title: Authority Seeding for AI: Building LLM Trust Signals · rawmktg.
item.description: A tactical playbook for building the niche-relevant backlinks, review signals, and third-party citations that feed AI training data, with domain-type prioritisation by vertical.

item.title: High-Citation Page Anatomy: What AI Engines Actually Pull · rawmktg.
item.description: Deconstruction of 10 pages that consistently earn AI citations across ChatGPT, Gemini, and Perplexity: shared patterns in heading structure, paragraph density, source-linking, and answer-lead formatting.

item.title: The 30-Day Content Half-Life: AI Recency Ranking Signal · rawmktg.
item.description: Content freshness in AI search is now a mechanical requirement, not a preference. A breakdown of why recency is a hard signal, how each platform weighs it, and a programmatic refresh system to keep your content inside the citation window.

item.title: India's Senior Living Sector Has an AI Visibility Problem · rawmktg.
item.description: A data-driven look at the SEO and GEO gap across three of India's leading senior living brands. The ChatGPT citation gap is 39×. The Gemini gap is 49×. And the most dangerous scenario isn't invisibility, it's misclassification.

item.title: How RAG Actually Works, And Why It Matters for GEO · rawmktg.
item.description: A technical breakdown of Retrieval-Augmented Generation for B2B marketing leaders. The five-stage AI search pipeline, what the GEO research actually shows, and a three-phase action plan for this quarter.

item.title: Autonomous Retail: The $74B Industry's AI Visibility Gap · rawmktg.
item.description: A DR 16 company has more AI citations than AiFi (DR 60), Standard AI (DR 55), and GetZippin combined. How a $74 billion market is being shaped by whoever shows up first in Google and ChatGPT.

item.title: CX SaaS SEO Analysis: 6 Companies, One Pattern · rawmktg.
item.description: We audited six B2B SaaS companies in the customer experience and survey software space. Six findings on organic traffic gaps, technical SEO debt, content funnel inversions, backlink quality, and AI visibility.

item.title: Container Tracking SaaS SEO & GEO: 6-Company Analysis · rawmktg.
item.description: We analysed six B2B SaaS companies in the container tracking software space across organic search, AI citations, referring domains, and keyword strategy. Seven findings from Ahrefs data.
